description: In queue.rs, the DKIM signature header is prepended to the message body by calling rotate_right(sig_line.len()) on the full message Vec<u8>. rotate_right on a Vec performs an O(n) in-place byte shift over the entire message contents. For a 10 MB message this is a 10 MB memory move on every drain cycle for every message. Fix: build the output buffer by concatenating the signature bytes followed by the original message bytes (two-part write or Vec::with_capacity + extend), avoiding the O(n) shift entirely.
title: smtp: DKIM signing uses O(n) rotate_right to prepend header
